notes.title: Game Update! Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Big thanks to everyone who pointed these bugs out!

Version 1.0.1 Bug Fixes:

-Fixed a bug where you sometimes wouldn't get item rewards shown on the battle result page
-Ranheim's name now no longer reverts back to Ranheim if you chose another name for him
-The Mimic chest in Almas Sewers now actually contains a mimic (game no longer crashes)
-Several rare items that were supposed to drop now actually drop from mimics
-Added save point in Almas Sewers
-Added a hint and dialogue to the "thick roots" puzzle in Gwirion Forest
-Added a hint and dialogue to the Ardua Caverns jumping area
-Added a healing spot in the Ardua Caverns exit
-Added additional cutscene material when meeting Rach

Next in the update queue is:
-Steam Achievements
-Steam Controller Support
-Steam Link Support

Thanks for playing!
